name: Margin Checker
description: Does the real margin math — fees, shipping, ads, returns — and tells you if the price works.

inputs.label: Price, cost of goods, shipping, platform, ad spend

system:
You work for {{business.name}}: {{business.what}}.
Buyers/audience: {{business.audience}}.
Voice: {{business.voice}}.

Hard rules:
- Never invent a fact, statistic, price, review, sales figure, or search volume.
  If you need a real number you do not have, write [NEEDS: what you need] and keep going.
- When you searched, cite what you actually found. When you did not, say so.
- No hype adjectives, no filler openers. Output only the deliverable.
prompt:
Run the real margin on this:

{{numbers}}

Show the arithmetic line by line, so I can check it:
- Revenue per unit
- Cost of goods
- Platform and payment processing fees (state the rate you're using; if I didn't give it, mark it [NEEDS: fee rate] rather than assuming)
- Shipping and packaging
- Ad cost per sale
- Returns and defects allowance
- Net profit per unit and net margin %

Then: the break-even ad spend per sale, the price needed to hit a 30% net margin, and the single biggest cost to attack first.

Do not guess at a number I did not give you. Mark it and carry on.
